about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-indg344 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: Words that are not on this page are added to the end of the last hand-arm vibration bullet.
findings.evidence: source: "especially when exposed for long periods?" / tree: "especially when exposed for long periods? visually examined on site and regularly inspected and tested by a competent person?’"

findings.problem: The picture caption is kept as body text under the Noise heading.
findings.evidence: tree: heading_path "Noise > Text", text "‘...have you limited the time that each worker uses high­vibration tools?’"

findings.problem: The two sub-bullets are joined into the first bullet as running text.
findings.evidence: tree: "suitable work methods and plant? Have you chosen the lowest vibration tool that is suitable and can do the job efﬁciently? Have you limited the time"

findings.problem: Hyphens are kept as soft-hyphen characters, so "hand-arm" and "high-vibration" can read as one word or a split word.
findings.evidence: source: "Hand-arm vibration", "high-vibration tools" / tree: "Hand­arm vibration", "high­ vibration tools"

findings.problem: The 'For more information, see' list of the Managing section is placed after the whole Reporting accidents text instead of at the end of Managing.
findings.evidence: source: "For more information, see: 1 Health and safety in construction HSG150" printed before "Reporting accidents" / tree: block managing-text-2 after reporting-accidents-text-1
source: "For more information, see:" / tree: "For moreinformation, see:"

findings.problem: The lead-in line 'You can notify the Contact Centre:' is joined to the end of the bullet before it instead of standing as its own line.
findings.evidence: tree: "then you should notify that too. You can notify the Contact Centre:"

findings.problem: The 'For more information, contact:' line and its one sentence of running text are read as a table with one column and one cell.
findings.evidence: source: "For more information, contact:" then "Training organisations (eg the Construction Industry Training Board) or HSE Infoline on 0845 345 0055" / tree: type "table"

findings.problem: The Employing note and its contact line are placed after the Subcontracting section, and the leaflet line printed at the top of the page is placed after Subcontracting too.
findings.evidence: source: "Incident at work? MISC769" at the top, "Note: If a person working under your control" before "Subcontracting" / tree: both after subcontracting-text-1

findings.problem: Two words are run together in the table text.
findings.evidence: source: "For more information, contact:" / tree: "For moreinformation, contact:"

findings.evidence: source: "stop people using an incomplete scaffold, eg where working" / tree: "eg where working ‘...have the wheels of tower scaffolds been locked when in use and are the platforms empty when they are moved?’ platforms are not fully boarded?"

findings.evidence: source: "‘...are there effective barriers or warning notices in place to stop people using an incomplete scaffold?’" / tree: text "‘...are there effective barriers or warning notices in place" and title "to stop people using an incomplete scaffold?’"

findings.evidence: source: "INDG401" before "Scaffolds" / tree: "INDG401" as the last block
